subject: Friday showcase — request to shift for CTO late join
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@clearline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Friday showcase — request to shift for CTO late join

Laura — quick heads up. We just heard from your events team that your CTO would like to join this Friday's 11:30 PT showcase as a late add. They’re transiting between meetings and indicated a tight 30-minute window during 11:15–11:45 PT.

Because several of our stakeholders are scheduled for the full 60-minute session, I wanted to surface options and pick whichever minimizes churn for your team:

Option A — compress the public portion and move the CTO segment to 11:15–11:45 PT (30 minutes) and run a follow-up deep-dive next week for the product/eng team.
Option B — shift the whole session earlier by 45 minutes so the CTO can join the end of the standard 60-minute flow (risk: conflicts for other attendees).
Option C — keep Friday time and have a short, focused CTO briefing (we can bring a tech lead + our CS lead and skip lower-priority slides).

Attached are an updated run-of-show (agenda-v2) and the mutual action plan (MAP) for quick alignment. If you confirm which option works, I’ll update the invite and loop in Vanessa as backup for the technical deep-dive in case we compress.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: agenda-v2.pdf (summary agenda), MAP-20270325.xlsx (mutual action plan)
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@clearline.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:50:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Friday showcase — request to shift for CTO late join

Diego — thanks for the quick note. Apologies for the late ask; the CTO's calendar just changed due to an investor call. He can realistically join only between 11:15–11:45 PT on Friday and needs the session to be tightly focused on architecture, latency SLAs, and our data retention discussion.

We'd prefer not to move other attendees if possible — Option A (compress the public portion and give the CTO a 30-minute focused slot) sounds best. If you can tighten the agenda and make the CTO window the priority, that would work.

One ask: can you ensure an engineer and someone from security are on the call for the CTO portion? Also any short pre-read on perf tests would help him come in ready.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Chen
Director, Procurement & Strategic Accounts
Clearline Financial
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 10:18:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Friday showcase — request to shift for CTO late join

Diego / team — copying in Monica and Vanessa to operationalize. Short notes and proposed plan: 

- We can compress to a 30-minute CTO-focused window (11:15–11:45 PT).
- Proposed run: 5' intro (Diego), 10' perf/latency (Karthik or engineer), 10' security/data retention (Monica), 5' next steps & SOW ask (Kim).
- Vanessa will own coordination and the follow-up deep-dive scheduling if we need the full product walkthrough for other stakeholders.
- I'll trim the slide deck and produce a 1-page pre-read (perf highlights + topline SLA numbers).

Operational asks:
- Diego: confirm that Clearline attendees (names + roles) will stay for the 30-min compressed session.
- Monica: can you bring a security SME (or Q&A-ready notes) for the CTO slot?

We should also send a brief calendar update with the new time-block and attach the pre-read.

Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Friday showcase — request to shift for CTO late join

Laura — thanks, we’ll take Option A. Confirming the plan:

- New Friday slot: 11:15–11:45 PT (compressed CTO session)
- Run: 5' intro (Diego), 10' perf & latency highlights (Karthik + perf engineer), 10' security & retention commitments (Monica), 5' next steps + SOW path (Kim)
- Follow-up: full product deep-dive for expanded stakeholder group (proposed Tue 29 Mar; Vanessa will own scheduling)

Attachments: agenda-v3.pdf (condensed CTO agenda), MAP-20270325.xlsx (updated mutual action plan) — both attached to the calendar update. Pre-read (one-pager perf highlights) will be in your inbox before EOD.

Calendar invite updated: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=clearline-demo-20270325
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CL-2027-045
DocuSign SOW (for reference): https://docusign.com/CL-2027-045/statement-of-work

Appreciate the accommodation — see you Friday.

Diego
